items.title: Eaton (ETN) Stock Sinks As Q3 Results Fail To Calm Execution Fears
items.summary: Eaton just dropped its Q3 2026 scorecard and the market flinched hard. The stock fell almost 10% today even as the industrial and electrical supplier reported what management called record revenue of about US$8.9b and an all time high adjusted earnings per share of US$3.68. That kind of one day selloff, coming after fresh guidance was lifted for full year organic growth and earnings, looks far more like a sentiment reset than a simple readthrough of the income statement.
